outputs.description:
A ProgramType object that can be assigned to Honeybee Rooms in
order to specify all default schedules and loads on the Room.
outputs.name: program

name: HB ProgramType

inputs.description:
Text to set the name for the ProgramType and to be incorporated
into a unique ProgramType identifier.
inputs.name: _name_

inputs.description:
An optional ProgramType object that will be used as the
starting point for the new ProgramType output from this component.
This can also be text for the name of a ProgramType within the library
such as that output from the "HB Search Program Types" component.
If unspecified, a Plenum program type will be used as the base with
no loads, setpoints, or ventilation requirements assigned.
inputs.name: base_program_

inputs.description:
A People object to describe the occupancy of the program. If unspecified,
no occupancy will be assumed for the program.
inputs.name: _people_

inputs.description:
A Lighting object to describe the lighting usage of the program.
If unspecified, no lighting will be assumed for the program.
inputs.name: _lighting_

inputs.description:
An ElectricEquipment object to describe the usage of electric
equipment within the program. If unspecified, no electric equipment
will be assumed for the program
inputs.name: _electric_equip_

inputs.description:
A GasEquipment object to describe the usage of gas equipment within
the program. If unspecified, no gas equipment will be assumed for
the program.
inputs.name: _gas_equip_

inputs.description:
A ServiceHotWater object to describe the usage of hot water
within the program. If unspecified, no hot water will be assumed for
the program.
inputs.name: _hot_water_

inputs.description:
An Infiltration object to describe the outdoor air leakage of
the program. If unspecified, no infiltration will be assumed for the
program.
inputs.name: _infiltration_

inputs.description:
A Ventilation object to describe the minimum outdoor air
requirement of the program. If unspecified, no ventilation requirement will
be assumed for the program.
inputs.name: _ventilation_

inputs.description:
An ExhaustAir object to describe the exhaust air requirement of
the program. If unspecified, no exhaust air requirement will be assumed for
the program.
inputs.name: _exhaust_

inputs.description:
A Setpoint object to describe the temperature and humidity
setpoints of the program.  If unspecified, the ProgramType cannot be assigned
to a Room that is conditioned.
inputs.name: _setpoint_

description:
Create a ProgramType object possessing all schedules and loads defining the
usage of a space.
_
ProgramTypes can be assigned to Honeybee Rooms to specify all default schedules
and loads on the Room.
-
